integrity: The lower bound is an exhaustive exact rational polynomial root count over all branch-level profiles with total size at most 12; the witness is supported by an independent exact enumeration over all 8192 bond states. Universal parameter validity follows from exact algebra, not numerical sampling.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to one initially infected fixed root, homogeneous independent edge infections on finite trees, and one fully effective pre-outbreak vaccinated non-root vertex. It does not apply to cyclic graphs, multiple doses, imperfect immunization, uncertain seed location, or other objectives.
title: Fourteen vertices are necessary and sufficient for reentrant optimal vaccination on rooted trees
